note: Frozen search strategy for docs/scoping/protocol.md. Queries are verbatim as sent. Changing any string here is a protocol deviation and must be logged in section 11 of the protocol, with the old string kept.

blocks.1: AI disclosure schemes: artificial intelligence AND disclosure AND scheme vocabulary
blocks.2: Adjacent disclosure traditions, without the AI concept: conflict of interest, funding, sponsored content and native advertising, contributorship, data and software citation
blocks.3: Known-item searches for schemes already named, so that a failure of block 1 to retrieve them becomes visible
